items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: And there was stuff going on that they were trying to keep undercover. For instance, that’s when Yoko was away in China somewhere and he was with — I don’t remember that name now — May Pang.

ctx.x: Did you get to hear the next day’s tune before you left?

No. Well not until the last day. Because it’s a very paranoid world you know. And there was stuff going on that they were trying to keep undercover. For instance, that’s when Yoko was away in China somewhere and he was with — I don’t remember that name now — May Pang. And there would always be people outside the studio, Beatle fans who wanted to give him a beaded collar or some kind of thing or something, or a poem that they wrote in 1966 in honor of him. And you never knew who was going to be there. But he…
Well that’s really a great story and the fact that you had that skill and could finally speak up and say I know how to make this happen. Were those other horn players, were they older than you?
